title: Seven more built-in titles look as refined as the redesigned five
goal: Editorial Serif, Light Leak, Behind Glass, Gradient Glow, and the Minimal Underline, Pill Card and Split Wipe name cards still use stock violet and electric blue, plain system type and "Your Title" placeholders, and score well below the five title pages redesigned on 2026-11-21 on the same blind test. Redesign them by the same colour and type rules so nothing on the titles shelf cheapens a video.
notes: Blind round 6 of task keynote-clean-soft-gradient-glass-kinetic-bold-t (2026-11-21, calm median 6.83, new five 6.83 to 7.58): Editorial Serif 6.17, Light Leak 5.67, Minimal Underline 5.25, Behind Glass 5.08, Pill Card 5.00, Gradient Glow 4.83, Split Wipe 4.50. Picture: queue/audits/2026-11-21-title-redesign-scores.png (bottom row). Frames and scorer setup: Tests/PhotonzMediaTests/TitleRedesignReelTests.swift writes others/hold-*.png beside the five (PHOTONZ_REEL=1 PHOTONZ_REDESIGN_PHASE=after PHOTONZ_REDESIGN_DIR=/tmp/redesign Scripts/test.sh --filter TitleRedesignReel). Code: Sources/PhotonzCore/TitleSet.swift (editorial, glass, lightLeak, gradientGlow, splitWipe, underline, pill). Keep TitleSetTests.movingLooks (looks shared by two at most, one light one dark) and twoSizes green. Name cards sit over footage: judge them there, legible over light and dark footage.
acceptance: Each of the seven is redesigned from the colour and type rules in docs/design/video-titles-polish.md (no saturated violet or electric blue ground, a chosen face, one deliberate typographic idea, sample copy that fits it)

On a blind vision-model score (held frames shuffled under random codes, three runs, same rubric as the 2026-11-21 audit), every one scores at or above the calm set median and above its own old version; all scores in the audit
Old documents holding any of the seven still open as they were, and shelf entries naming them open the new design, with a test
A reel and an old-beside-new contact sheet under queue/audits/

log.note: Triage 2026-11-22: moved up near the head of p2. This finishes what the user asked for on 2026-11-21 (no title on the shelf that cheapens a video). The redesign covered five of the twelve that score below the calm set.

owns these walks: title-set-editorial-serif-walk, title-set-behind-glass-walk, title-set-light-leak-walk, title-set-gradient-glow-walk, title-set-split-wipe-walk, title-set-minimal-underline-walk, title-set-pill-card-walk

Adversarial review before building: these sit on the shelf as tiles that play, so they must read at tile size and frame 0; walks and tests find them by name and part path, so raw values, names and part paths (Title, Subtitle, Kicker, Rule, Gradient, Headline, Name, Role, Edge, Mark, Shade, Background) are kept and only the drawing changes. Name cards sit over the person's footage, so legibility over light and dark footage is the floor (TitleSetTests.legible, TitleSetFramesTests). A moving look lifts every light to strong colour, so each look runs at a low strength in one warm or sage temperature. Pill Card's round gradient mark is a blob standing in for a logo (rule 7): it becomes a short sage rule.

Chose keeping the seven names over renaming them because each still says what it is (Split Wipe, Pill Card, Gradient Glow still has a sliding gradient, now champagne) and 18 walks find them by name. Chose a short sage rule over an initials monogram for Pill Card's mark because a monogram needs a third type size and a person's own initials to mean anything.

Blind score rounds (3 runs each, 29 frames, fresh random codes each round). Round 1: calm median 6.30; new 6.37-7.87 (Pill 6.37, Glass 6.47 marginal); old 3.47-5.17. Round 2 (after calming Editorial's sketch and Pill's bubbles): calm median 6.72; Glass 6.00, Pill 5.90, Split Wipe 6.20, Gradient Glow 6.57 under it, Glass unchanged since round 1 so ~0.5 is scorer noise. Third pass on those four (Glass as a low flush-left chapter card, ivory Pill with no mark, quieter rays and glow, Futura Medium). Round 3 (final): calm median 6.30; Editorial 7.80, Light Leak 7.77, Gradient Glow 7.27, Underline 7.10, Glass 7.07, Pill 6.77, Split Wipe 6.63; old 3.40-4.93.

Chose an ivory pill over a dark one for Pill Card because the critics read the dark pill as muddy with its bubbles and mark, and a light pill with a soft shadow is the one card of the three that stands apart from the footage. Chose a flush-left low chapter card for Behind Glass over centred type because centred Avenir read as generic in two rounds.

Fixed on the way: a stack measured a piece stretched across it when working out its own width, so Minimal Underline's rule stayed as long as the widest font pair's words after turning a font pair back (TitleRestyleTests.knobsTurnBack failed on it; StretchedPieceShrinksBackTests reproduces it on a bare column). GroupFlow.stacked now leaves cross-stretched pieces out of the cross extent, as GroupFlow.size already did. TitleSetFramesTests now judges a name card's 'shows something while it holds' on its corner, as it already photographs it: a dark card with fine type over dark footage vanished in a 160x90 thumbnail.

Looked at: scores grid (new seven read as designed, none violet/blue; old seven stock violet/blue with placeholders), old-new contact sheet (no title at 0 ms, all in by 1100 ms), the seven window captures from the walks (real app, Screen Recording granted, unlocked) and a close crop of the three cards (Pill's lines were tight after typing a name: gap widened 2 -> 8). Walks: 7 title-set walks ok on a rebuilt probe; 12 others naming these titles ok except title-presets-library-shelf-walk (Film Super tile, already owned by the-title-presets-walk-pulls-film-super-off-the, logged there). Scripts/test.sh green (full suite).

Seven titles redesigned (commit 71a7bdb37, Sources/PhotonzCore/TitleSet.swift): Editorial Serif, Behind Glass, Light Leak, Gradient Glow, Split Wipe, Minimal Underline, Pill Card, each with a chosen face, a neutral ground, one accent and sample copy. Final blind round (3 runs, 29 frames): calm median 6.30, new 6.63-7.80, old 3.40-4.93. TitleRedesignSevenTests holds the rules, shelf entries and old documents; StretchedPieceShrinksBackTests covers the stretched-rule fix found on the way. Reel, old-new sheet, scores grid and 7 window captures in queue/audits. 19 walks run (one known unrelated failure, logged on its owner); full Scripts/test.sh green.
